title: Gamer Night
blurb: Rage quits, speedrun brags and the games you secretly still love. Controllers down for this one.

dare: Do your best victory dance after defeating a final boss.
Act out being a character trapped in a loop of the same line of dialogue.
Mime playing a rhythm game on an invisible dance mat for 15 seconds.
Narrate the next player's turn like a speedrun commentator.
Do a dramatic 'game over' scene, then respawn.
Be an NPC who only repeats one phrase until your next turn.
Pretend to be a character selecting their fighter in a fighting game.
Do your best impression of a gamer rage-quitting a match.
Mime a dramatic fall in a platformer game, then do your victory pose.
Describe your day as if it's a game level, with bosses and loot.
Demonstrate your best 'loading screen' face for 15 seconds.
Do a flawless impression of a very enthusiastic game tutorial voice.
Act out a pixelated character walking in a straight line, like an old game.
Present your own character class, stats and special move.
Give an imaginary teammate the most dramatic high five of all time.
Pretend you've just found a hidden treasure chest in a game, then react to what's in it.
Narrate yourself getting a new skill and levelling up.
Pitch a ridiculous new video game to the room.
Pretend to have glitched, and freeze in a weird pose for 20 seconds.
Make the sound effects of a retro game for 15 seconds.
Fight an invisible dragon using a cushion as your sword.
Pretend to be a shopkeeper in a role-playing game selling an overpriced potion.
